rules: 15min bars; reaction = closure: extreme bar's low (high) below the 2 prior bars AND the lowest low (highest high) of the prior 20 bars (the swept low); opposing series = contiguous down-close (up-close) candles ending at the extreme (or <=2 bars before), <=10 long; first close beyond that series' first-candle OPEN within 10 candles, no new extreme first
T0 = the closing candle's close; R = |close - extreme|; expansion level E = close + 1R

stale: M1 bars starting in [T0, T0+20min) (>= 18) touched neither E nor the swept extreme; decision_time = T0 + 20 min; outcome from the first M1 open at/after it (P20): E before the extreme within 1380 M1 bars (same bar 0.5, neither dropped)

control = a FRESH reaction (any closure of the same detector, same direction, T0 within +/-30 days and NY clock within +/-30 min of the stale decision time, not the event's own) scored the same way from the first M1 open at/after ITS T0 against ITS OWN E and extreme

geometry: driftless P(E first) = dn/(up+dn) from the start price; null = fresh outcome - its ratio + the stale event's ratio, 5 draws; claim '-': 20 idle minutes lower the expansion rate below a fresh reaction's (downgrade to consolidation)
